acceptanceCriteria: A reusable command gate's reuse key covers the values (or a digest of the values) of the declared environment variables that can change the result, such as the toolchain selected by PATH/GOTOOLCHAIN, or the spec states which values are excluded and why, with owner acceptance.
A test shows that a PASS recorded under a different value of a keyed variable is not reused; one mutation that drops the value from the key fails it.
body: Residual from the V1-1415 lane (PR #931, head 389485b19, merge-base 53e7e3df2). The reuse key of a reusable:true COMMAND gate is the definition digest (argv, cwd, env names, timeout, expected exit, reusable, required) plus the tree, inputs and environment digests, but the environment digest covers only which declared variables are present, not their values. Expected: a PASS run under a different toolchain or PATH is not reused. Actual: it qualifies if the same variable names are present. Matters before full-gate (make gate: GOCACHE, GOTOOLCHAIN, PATH, HOME, TMPDIR) is declared reusable.
title: suspected: Tasks gate reuse keys environment variable names only, so a PASS under a different toolchain/PATH can be reused
